app.title: Product name. Do not translate.
titleBar.minimize: Tooltip of the window's minimize button. Use the wording Windows uses in your language.
titleBar.maximize: Tooltip of the window's maximize button. Use the wording Windows uses in your language.
titleBar.restore: Tooltip of the maximize button while the window is maximized. Use the wording Windows uses in your language.
titleBar.close: Tooltip of the window's close button. Closing keeps Aemeath running in the notification area.
shell.empty: Temporary text in the empty main area during early development.
